related_questions.question: How to look up property taxes in Maryland?

text_blocks.snippet: To look up Maryland property tax information, visit the Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT) website and use their Real Property Data Search tool. You can search by address, account identifier, or map reference. For more detailed records or in-person assistance, visit the local county courthouse or the Department of Finance in your county.
snippet_highlighted_words: visit the Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT) website and use their Real Property Data Search tool

text_blocks.snippet: Steps to find property tax information in Maryland:

list.title: 1. Go to the Maryland SDAT website:
list.snippet: Access the official Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT) website.

list.title: 2. Use the Real Property Data Search:
list.snippet: Locate and use the Real Property Data Search tool on the SDAT website.

list.title: 3. Enter Property Information:
list.snippet: You can search by address, account identifier (parcel ID), or map reference.

list.title: 4. View Property Details:
list.snippet: The search results will display property information, including the owner's name, property value, and tax information.

list.title: 5. Access Local County Information:
list.snippet: For detailed tax bills or payment information, you may need to visit the specific county's website or office.

list.title: 6. In-person Assistance:
list.snippet: If you need further assistance or can't find the information online, visit the local county courthouse or the Department of Finance in your county.
